Get clusters minimal data

Retrieve essential cluster data required for common operations (e.g., workload submission)

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
filterBy
Array of strings <= 10 items [^(name)(==|!=|<=|>=|=@|!@|=\^|=\$).+$]
Example: filterBy=name==my-cluster

Filter clusters by a parameter. Use the format field-name operator value. Operators are == Equals, != Not equals, <= Less than or equal, >= Greater than or equal. Dates are in ISO 8601 timestamp format and available for operators ==, !=, <= and >=.

offset
integer <int32>
Example: offset=100

The offset of the first item returned in the collection.

limit
integer <int32> [ 1 .. 500 ]
Default: 50

The maximum number of entries to return.

Delete a cluster by id.

Use to delete a cluster by Universally Unique Identifier (UUID). Will return 202 for success if this api was called on a cluster that its version is >=2.20, and force query param is false or not provided. Will return 204 for success if force query param is true, or if cluster is in a version < 2.20

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
clusterUuid
required
string <uuid> non-empty
Example: 9f55255e-11ed-47c7-acef-fc4054768dbc

The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

query Parameters
force
boolean
Default: false
Example: force=true

if true will force cluster instant deletion otherwise will start cluster graceful deletion process.

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/clusters/{clusterUuid}

Response samples

  • 202
  • 401
  • 403
  • 500
  • 503
Content type
application/json
{
  • "code": 202,
  • "message": "Request has been accepted."
}

Get the cluster metrics data.

Retrieve the metrics data for a Kubernetes cluster by Universally Unique Identifier (UUID).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
clusterUuid
required
string <uuid> non-empty
Example: 9f55255e-11ed-47c7-acef-fc4054768dbc

The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

query Parameters
start
required
string <date-time>
Example: start=2023-06-06T12:09:18.211Z

Start date of time range to fetch data in ISO 8601 timestamp format.

end
required
string <date-time>
Example: end=2023-06-07T12:09:18.211Z

End date of time range to fetch data in ISO 8601 timestamp format.

numberOfSamples
integer [ 0 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: numberOfSamples=20

The number of samples to take in the specified time range.

metricType
required
Array of strings (MetricsType)
Items Enum: "TOTAL_GPU_NODES" "GPU_UTILIZATION" "GPU_UTILIZATION_DISTRIBUTION" "GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION" "CPU_UTILIZATION" "CPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION" "TOTAL_GPU" "GPU_QUOTA" "ALLOCATED_GPU" "UNALLOCATED_GPU" "AVG_WORKLOAD_WAIT_TIME" "WORKLOADS_COUNT"

specifies what data to request

groupBy
string
Enum: "Category" "Nodepool" "Project" "Department"
Example: groupBy=Category

Labels to group the returned metrics data by. Grouping availability depends on the selected metric type. Supported values: "category" (workload category) or "node pool".

nodepoolName
string
Example: nodepoolName=default

Filter using the nodepool.

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/clusters/{clusterUuid}/metrics

Response samples

  • 207
  • 400

  • 403
  • 404
  • 422
  • 500
  • 503

      • "type": "ALLOCATED_GPU",

          • "value": "85",

Retrieve the installation instructions of a cluster by ID.

Use to retrieve installation instruction for a cluster by Universally Unique Identifier (UUID). Supports clusters version 2.15 or above.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
clusterUuid
required
string <uuid> non-empty
Example: 9f55255e-11ed-47c7-acef-fc4054768dbc

The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

query Parameters
version
required
string
Example: version=2.16

The cluster version to install

remoteClusterUrl
string
Example: remoteClusterUrl=https://cluster.runai

The remote URL of the runai cluster

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/clusters/{clusterUuid}/cluster-install-info

Response samples

  • 200
  • 401
  • 403
  • 404
  • 500
  • 503
Content type
application/json
{
  • "installationStr": "helm upgrade -i runai-cluster runai/runai-cluster -n runai --set cluster.uid=... --set cluster.bootstrapToken=<installer-bootstrap-jwt>",
  • "repositoryName": "runai",
  • "chartRepoURL": "https://charts.example.com",
  • "bootstrapToken": "<installer-bootstrap-jwt>"
}

Update node details.

Use to update the details of a node in a Kubernetes cluster by Universally Unique Identifier (UUID).

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
clusterUuid
required
string <uuid> non-empty
Example: 9f55255e-11ed-47c7-acef-fc4054768dbc

The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

nodeName
required
string

The node name.

Request Body schema: application/json
required

The node info in the cluster.

status
required
string
Enum: "Ready" "NotReady" "Unknown" "MissingPrerequisites"

The calculated status of the node.

Array of objects (NodeStatusConditionDetails)
Array of objects (NodeTaint)
nodePool
required
string

The node's NodePool.

createdAt
required
string <date-time>
object or null (GpuInfo)
nvLinkDomainUid
string or null

NV Link Domain Uid

nvLinkCliqueId
string or null

NV Link Clique Id

Array of objects or null (NetworkTopologyLabelsOptional)

A list of Kubernetes node label key/value pairs that represent the node’s position in the cluster’s network topology (for example, region, zone, block, rack, or hostname). The topology is attached to the node pool on which the workload runs. The label order represents the hierarchy, from farthest (first) to closest (last). These labels are used by the NVIDIA Run:ai Scheduler when making placement decisions.

object or null (NumaInfo)

Responses

http://localhost:8080/api/v1/clusters/{clusterUuid}/nodes/{nodeName}

required

Array of objects (NodeForSync)
from

The first node to sync. Will delete all nodes that don't exist in the request, after this node. If empty, all nodes before the first one sent will be deleted.

Sync NUMA nodes in a cluster.

Syncs NUMA-node snapshots for one or more physical nodes. Use deleteMissing for paginated full-cluster reconciliation.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
path Parameters
clusterUuid
required
string <uuid> non-empty
Example: 9f55255e-11ed-47c7-acef-fc4054768dbc

The Universally Unique Identifier (UUID) of the cluster.

Request Body schema: application/json
required

NUMA-node snapshots to sync.

required
Array of objects (NodeNumaForSync)

Physical nodes and their complete NUMA-node snapshots.

deleteMissing
boolean
Default: false

When true, delete NUMA-node details for physical nodes in the requested range that are missing from nodes. Used for full-cluster reconciliation.

from
string

The inclusive lower physical-node-name boundary for deletion when deleteMissing is true. If omitted, the range is unbounded below.

to
string

The inclusive upper physical-node-name boundary for deletion when deleteMissing is true. If omitted, the range is unbounded above.

Responses

Count the amount of network topologies in a tenant.

Retrieve the count of network topologies in a tenant group by selected attributes

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
filterBy
Array of strings <= 10 items [^(name|clusterId|source|phase)(==|!=|<=|>=|=@...]
Example: filterBy=clusterId==123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000,source=@Run.ai

Filter results by a parameter. Use the format field-name operator value. Supported operators: == Equals != Not equals <= Less than or equal >= Greater than or equal =@ Contains !@ Does not contain =^ Starts with =$ Ends with Date values must be in ISO 8601 timestamp format. Only the following operators support dates: ==, !=, <=, >=.
